name: USDA county yield atlas v2
scope: contiguous U.S. counties excluding California; corn, soybean, and wheat; 2010–2025
source: USDA NASS Quick Stats published county yields

gate.rule: On identical 2019–2025 rows, 2010–2025 history must improve pooled Spearman and percentile MAE; extended coverage must not decrease.

uncertaintyValidation.method: Crop- and history-count-conditional split conformal absolute-error intervals around the earlier-year county mean.

gate.rule: 2018–2025 pooled coverage must be 77–85% for the 80% interval and 87–94% for the 90% interval; mean 90% width <= 0.55; every crop >= 85% 90%-interval coverage.

disclaimer: Observed county prior with retrospectively calibrated uncertainty; not a parcel yield forecast, causal estimate, or purchase recommendation.
